note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/alt_text_review.py or a plain string check; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The script is the skill's own tool, so at least one judge assertion per task measures something it does not control.

evals.prompt: Fix the alt text on this product page. The file image_facts.md says what each image shows. Save the result as page_fixed.html.
assertions: [script] alt_text_review.py page_fixed.html exits 0 or reports only flags the reply explains
[script] the divider image in page_fixed.html has alt="" and the basket link image has a non-empty alt
[script] no alt in page_fixed.html starts with 'image of' or 'picture of' and none contains a file extension
[judge] The basket alt names the action or destination (cart), not the picture
[judge] Alt text uses only facts from image_facts.md: green kettle, water-level window, limescale filter; no invented details
[judge] The reply ends with a short report listing what changed and what was not checked

evals.prompt: The two images in volunteers.md are a bar chart of weekly sign-ups (data is in the paragraph under it) and a flowchart of our volunteer intake: Register, Interview, Training, Placement, with an Interview that can send people back to Register. Make both accessible.
assertions: [script] alt_text_review.py on the edited file reports no complex_no_long_description flag
[script] each of the two alt texts is 125 characters or fewer
[script] the edited file still contains '12 in March' and '48 in June'
[judge] The flowchart long description lists the four steps in order and the loop from Interview back to Register
[judge] The chart alt states the type and the takeaway; the full data is not stuffed into alt
[judge] Nothing in the descriptions states a number or step the user did not give

evals.prompt: Add alt text to the three team photos in notes.md.
assertions: [script] if the agent edits the file, no alt contains a person's name or a physical description (no text invented)
[judge] The agent asks the user what each photo shows and why it is on the page, instead of inventing descriptions
[judge] The agent does not treat the empty-alt images as confirmed decorative without asking
[judge] The agent says it cannot see the images
